cpeg.note: theta_block is the 98th percentile and theta_low the 95th percentile of the generic benign validation energy (out-of-fold, 5 folds). The grid search recorded theta_release = -7.4153 (below every benchmark-harmful training energy); the band rule then sets theta_release := theta_low (inside the band a Gate1 block stands), so the deployed bands carry theta_release = theta_low = theta_del = 0.2209 and the -7.4153 value has no effect on any decision. g1_low_block is absent: below theta_low the request passes whatever Gate1 says.

ablation_no_probes.note: No probes: the same fine-tuned encoder as CPEG, E = s0 (the request's logit alone, no probes, no head), bands chosen by the same rule (98th / 95th percentile of the generic benign validation logit, theta_release := theta_low).

ablation_energy_gate_only.rule: block if E >= cpeg.bands.theta_block, else pass
